Title: Turbo module with Summon History + Camarilla Vitae Slave

Messages.Author: Surreal
Messages.Body:
I think there could be some good turbo deck made out of that module. First I was thinking Lydia, Grand Praetor. You basically just need pile of Summon History and Force of Will + couple Soul Gem and Vitae Slave. Fetch Soul Gem with first Summon. Summon on next turn to fetch Vitae Slave and use all but one blood for it. Bleed with inferior Force of Will to make Lydia burn and continue with next Lydia. If you get blocked playing Force of Will use Lydias ability to get stealth and make her burn and continue with next one.

Problem with turbo is that there is usually too many moving parts. With Lydia you basically just need two cards after setup. Other good cards to add to deck are Hourglass of the Mind (and potence version is good too with some Domain of Evernight). Then some Tangles and few Recurring Contemplation to manage blockers. Deck might be also safer with some freak drives and darings. Rest of the cards + bleed modifiers.

Biggest problem with Lydia is managing blockers and intercept. Also Lydia doesn't have so strong bleed.

Other option might to make this deck with Ian Forestal with some other weird tech. Any ideas?
